claims.statement: fast_safety_filter strips provider reasoning, code fences, <minimax: tags, Markdown bold/headings/hr, then computes empty_after_clean, too_long_for_chat (>1800), and _RISK_RE (structural leakage / Vietnamese leakage phrases); needs_llm_safety is true only when one of those fires, so the LLM judge is reserved for genuine ambiguity.

strip_think_reasoning removes complete <think>…</think> blocks and discards any text after an unmatched <think opener so a truncated provider response never leaks deliberation as user-visible content.

A blocklist_hit (prompt-injection patterns in English + Vietnamese, vulgarity, self-harm) routes the reply to retry_exhausted_fallback and skips the LLM judge entirely (Slice E.1); the LLM judge is consulted only on the flag, and at most one retry/rewrite is allowed before the deterministic fallback.

retry_exhausted_fallback selects TECHNICAL_FALLBACK when the user message matches the off-domain technical regex (code, debug), otherwise the generic Vietnamese FALLBACK_REPLY; truncate_for_chat caps output at 1800 chars on a word boundary with an ellipsis.

validate_grounding diffs cited job IDs (id=<uuid> or bare UUID) against surfaced_ids; hallucinated IDs are stripped case-insensitively, and the reply is fully replaced only when nothing grounded remains after stripping.

validate_entity_grounding pulls company/factory/project names from structured ACTIVE_JOB_LOOKUP_JSON payloads (jobs + alternative_jobs) and appends a hedging footer for unsupported entity claims, leaving the reply body intact (sanitize-only).

route_turn classifies turns with deterministic Vietnamese diacritic-insensitive markers; priority order is empty/internal_retry → out_of_scope → fast_lane → timetable → contact/phone → recommendation → profile → vacancy_lookup → detail → general.

should_use_fast_model returns True only for strategies in FAST_MODEL_STRATEGIES = frozenset({"template", "knowledge_lookup", "safe_redirect"}); recommendation, profile, and general-agent paths always use the reasoning model.
detect_salary_sort_intent returns salary_desc or salary_asc based on Vietnamese markers; sap xep / sx without direction defaults to salary_desc; returns None when neither salary keyword matches.
detect_recency_sort_intent treats gan nhat / moi nhat as "most recently posted" (temporal recency), not geographically nearest, and returns "created_at" when the markers match.

fast_lane.py uses zero LLM calls for non-factual traffic (greetings, thanks, goodbye, help-meta); factual questions (salary, shuttle, work location, contacts, interview schedule, age/KTX) are explicitly excluded and fall through to the RAG + agent path.

The pre-send claim fence (svc.claim_send) atomically transitions the pending row PENDING→SENDING gated on conversation version, lock_owner, and the pending message id; rowcount=0 yields outcome=suppressed rather than an empty "Gửi lỗi" bubble, closing the recheck→send TOCTOU.
